PLAN "12-Week Cardiac Rehab Maintenance: General Fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Build general fitness and muscular endurance at moderate intensity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
